skills.description: A specialized skill for generating CCER (Chinese Certified Emission Reduction) Project Design Documents for afforestation/forestry carbon sink projects under methodology CCER-14-001-V01. This skill is built on a real approved case (Hongyuan County protection forest project, 890.63 ha, 40-year crediting period) and incorporates 7 corrective actions + 1 observation from a real CCSC validation. It guides users through carbon layer division, biomass calculations (using Appendix A equations), soil organic carbon changes, dead organic matter, sample plot design, monitoring plan, and uniqueness declaration generation. Use this skill when the user mentions 造林碳汇, 林业碳汇, 防护林, 人工造林, 用材林, 灌木造林, afforestation, CCER-14-001-V01, 森林碳汇, 林草碳汇, or requests to write a PDD for a forestry carbon sink project.
